auth.register.description: Guhingura igikapu c’urufunguzo rw’ibanga ry’umutekano n’igikoresho cawe. Nta bumenyi bwa crypto bukenewe.
auth.register.securityNote: Igikapu cawe gikinzwe n’ibipimo vy’ubuzima vy’igikoresho cawe. Nta mfunguruzo z’ibanga ziva ku gikoresho cawe.
auth.sign.title: Rema konti yawe
auth.sign.description: Suzuma ido n'ido ryawe maze wemeze
auth.sign.cooldown: Ivyiyumviro vyinshi cane. Gerageza kandi muri
auth.login.signInDescription: Koresha urufunguzo rwawe kugira ngo ushikire konti yawe ata nkomanzi.
auth.login.noPasskey: Nta rufunguzo rw'ibanga rwabonetse kuri iki gikoresho.
landing.heroDesc: Ivyiyumviro vy’ubuzigama vyegerejwe kuri Stellar. Zero abahuza. Ubusegaba bw’ivy’ubutunzi ku bantu miliyaridi 1,3 batagira amabanki.
landing.contractsLabel: Amasezerano ya Soroban · Urubuga rwa mbere
landing.feat1Desc: Amasezerano y’ubwenge ashira mu ngiro itegeko ryose. Nta mutegura ashobora guhunga n’ikidengeri. Intererano yose isuzumwa ku ruzitiro.
landing.feat2Desc: Umuntu wese afise igikapu ca Stellar. Nta konti ya banki. Nta gusuzuma inguzanyo. Nta mipaka.
landing.feat3Desc: Yubaka MoiScore yawe n’intererano yose utanga ku gihe. Indangamuntu y’ivy’ubutunzi ishobora gutwara.
landing.feat4Desc: Ivy’amasenti y’inyenyeri bituma inzinguzingu z’umusi ku musi zikora. Nta mafaranga y’urubuga yo kurema canke kwinjiramwo.
landing.feat5Desc: Imburakimazi, idahinduka, icamunara, canke itora. Uruziga rwawe, amategeko yawe.
landing.feat6Desc: USDC uno musi. Ibindi bice vy’amahera bikomeye ku ikarita y’inzira.
landing.readyDesc: Rema uruziga rwawe rwa mbere rwo kuzigama mu minota mikeyi.
